concepts.title: Degree to Radian Conversion
concepts.definition: Converts an angular measurement from degrees, minutes, and seconds into the equivalent radian measure.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply the degree value by pi divided by 180.
question_patterns: convert degrees to radians
find the radian measure of an angle of ... degrees
what is the radian equivalent of ... degrees ... minutes
express the degree angle in radians
Explain the method of Degree to Radian Conversion.

solution_steps.explain: Divide the minutes by 60 to express them as a fraction of a degree, then add to the degrees.
Multiply the total degrees by pi and divide by 180.
Reduce the fraction by canceling common factors between the numerator and 180 to express the radian in simplest form.

concepts.title: Radian to Degree Conversion
concepts.definition: Converts an angular measurement from radians into degrees, minutes, and seconds.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply the radian value by 180 divided by pi.
question_patterns: convert radians to degrees
find the degree measure of ... radians
what is the degree equivalent of ... radians
express the radian angle in degrees, minutes, and seconds
Explain the method of Radian to Degree Conversion.

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the radian measure by 180 and divide by pi.
Find the integer part of the total degrees.
Multiply the fractional part of degrees by 60 to get total minutes.
Find the integer part of the total minutes.
Multiply the fractional part of minutes by 60 to get seconds.

concepts.title: Arc Length, Radius, and Angle Relation
concepts.definition: Relates the length of a circular arc to the radius of the circle and the subtended central angle in radians.
concepts.key_idea: The arc length is the product of the radius and the central angle in radians.
question_patterns: find the arc length of a circle
calculate the distance moved by the tip of a hand
how far does the tip move in ... minutes
find the radius given arc length and angle
Explain the method of Arc Length, Radius, and Angle Relation.

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the degree measure by pi and divide by 180.
Multiply the radius by the angle in radians.
Confirm the arc length has the same units as the radius and check that the angle was correctly converted to radians before multiplying.

concepts.title: Finding Trigonometric Functions from One Given Ratio
concepts.definition: Calculates the values of other trigonometric functions given one ratio and the quadrant of the angle.
concepts.key_idea: Use Pythagorean identities and determine signs based on the quadrant.
question_patterns: find the values of other five trigonometric functions
given cos x = ... in quadrant ... find sin x
calculate the trigonometric ratios when tan x is given
what are the other trigonometric functions if cot x is ...
Explain the method of Finding Trigonometric Functions from One Given Ratio.

solution_steps.explain: Use the identity sin^2 x = 1 - cos^2 x.
Take the square root of sin^2 x.
Multiply the absolute value of sine by the quadrant sign multiplier.

Explain the method of Trigonometric Functions of Sum and Difference of Angles.

solution_steps.explain: Apply the identity sin(a + b) = sin a cos b + cos a sin b.
Plug in the standard trigonometric values for the component angles, such as sin 30, cos 45, etc.
Compute the numerical sum and simplify any radicals or fractions to obtain the final value.

concepts.title: Double Angle Formulas
concepts.definition: Expresses trigonometric ratios of twice an angle in terms of the single angle's ratios.
concepts.key_idea: Reduce double angles to single angles using algebraic identities.
question_patterns: find the value of sin 2x
calculate cos 2x from sin x
express tan 2x in terms of tan x
what is the double angle value of sine
Explain the method of Double Angle Formulas.

solution_steps.explain: Apply the identity sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x.
Apply the identity cos 2x = cos^2 x - sin^2 x or an equivalent form.
Apply the identity tan 2x = 2 tan x / (1 - tan^2 x).

concepts.title: Triple Angle Formulas
concepts.definition: Expresses trigonometric ratios of three times an angle in terms of the single angle's ratios.
concepts.key_idea: Expand triple angles into single-angle cubic expressions.
question_patterns: find the value of sin 3x
calculate cos 3x
express tan 3x in terms of tan x
what is the triple angle value of sine
Explain the method of Triple Angle Formulas.

solution_steps.explain: Apply the identity sin 3x = 3 sin x - 4 sin^3 x.
Apply the identity cos 3x = 4 cos^3 x - 3 cos x.
Apply the identity tan 3x = (3 tan x - tan^3 x) / (1 - 3 tan^2 x).

concepts.formula: cos_x + cos_y = 2 * cos((x + y) / 2) * cos((x - y) / 2)
concepts.key_idea: Factorize trigonometric sums into products of average and half-difference angles.

concepts.title: Half-Angle Formulas
concepts.definition: Computes trigonometric ratios of half an angle using the cosine of the full angle and the quadrant of the half-angle.
concepts.key_idea: Find the half-angle sine or cosine magnitude and apply the appropriate quadrant sign.
question_patterns: find sin(x/2) given tan x
calculate cos(x/2) when cos x is known
evaluate tan(x/2) in quadrant ...
find half-angle trigonometric values
Explain the method of Half-Angle Formulas.

solution_steps.explain: Use the half-angle formula sin(x/2) = sqrt((1 - cos x) / 2).
Multiply by the sign multiplier of the quadrant containing the half-angle.
Cross-check by substituting the half-angle result back into the identity sin x = 2 sin(x/2) cos(x/2) to confirm consistency.
